description: This file defines command policies and allowlists for different platform nodes in the OpenClaw system, including command categorization, platform normalization, and permission checks.

methods.name: resolveNodeCommandAllowlist
methods.description: Generates a set of allowed commands for a node based on platform, device, and configuration allow/deny lists.

methods.name: normalizeDeclaredNodeCommands
methods.description: Normalizes a list of declared commands, filtering by allowlist.

methods.name: isNodeCommandAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific command is allowed for a node, considering declaration and allowlist.
